actual_invocation.prompt: Generate an original low-poly DESIGN CONCEPT sheet for a fossil shell inspired by Aturia, before any 3D model is built. Show the SAME compact shell in three compatible views: broad side, narrow edge, and three-quarter. Smooth inflated tightly involute coil with only a small shallow umbilical dimple; a broad rounded outer rim, thick swollen whorl section, subtle termination/apertural lip at lower-right. Fossil shell only, no animal, no tentacles, no pedestal, no ammonite ribs or horns. Gentle low-poly plane transitions; warm chalky pale sandstone/ivory with a few subdued ochre fossil patches. Whole object in each view, isolated neutral grey background, soft studio lighting, no text or symbols. Nominal designed shell width 0.24 m, thickness 0.105 m, height 0.22 m; measurements are artistic scale, not specimen data. Keep coil upright and show true thickness. Quiet broad surface with restrained shallow spiral seam; avoid a flat disc or exposed several open spiral turns.
